acknowledging.use: The Worker's answer to a delegation, within Linear's ten seconds. Ephemeral: the pickup replaces it.

heard.use: The Worker's answer to a mention or a reply, within Linear's ten seconds.

looking.use: A conversation's pickup: something to answer, not to change.

starting.use: Starting on work when there's no issue to link to.
phrases: Getting the lie of the land first…

reading-reply.use: A reply passed on to the work already under way.

reading-issue.use: Reading the issue and its comments.

reading-code.use: Reading the code before changing it.
phrases: Reading the code. Some of it twice…
Reading the tests too. Especially the tests…
Learning the lie of this module…
Turning my head further than is comfortable…

investigating.use: Working out a cause, or an answer to a question.
phrases: Ruling things out, one by one…
Tracing it back to the source…
Looking for the cause, not the symptom…
Waiting for the cause to move…

reading-review.use: Reading review feedback on a PR.
phrases: Sorting the fixes from the rest…
Checking each comment on its merits…
Taking the feedback in, without sulking…
Reading the review, one eye narrowed…
Bringing the branch up to date…

stopping.use: The Worker's answer to a stop, until the stop is done.

editing.use: A worker's hook: an edit to a file, or a command that writes one. `path` names it, repo-relative.

reading.use: A worker's hook: a file read, or a command that prints one.

searching.use: A worker's hook: a search of the code or its files.

building.use: A worker's hook: a build, type check or lint.

rebasing.use: A worker's hook: a fetch, rebase, pull or merge.
rebasing.plain: Bringing the branch up to date

history.use: A worker's hook: any other git command.

working.use: A worker's hook: a script run, whose text says nothing of what it does.

command.use: A worker's hook: any other command. Never echoes it.

delegating.use: A worker's hook: a sub-agent, such as the deep review's.
delegating.plain: Handing part of it to a second pair of eyes

looking-up.use: A worker's hook: a web search or fetch.

actions.rebasing: Bringing the branch up to date
actions.delegating: Asking a second pair of eyes
